stage_35_claim.claim: the lane's stage 35 says its speed work changes nothing sent, absorbed or drawn, with an old-vs-new differential oracle
hunks_read: lever (b)(iii): `k(c).mul(x)` becomes `x.mul_base(k(c).c0)` for the thirteen public constants of slots 14 and 17.  The constants are `Fp2::from_i64` of public integers, so their imaginary part is zero and the two are the same field element; the change is which multiplication routine runs
lever (b)(ii): `k_den * d` and `k_den * dm`, each formed twice in slot 14's closure, are formed once and reused.  `k_den.mul(y).mul(d)` becomes `(k_den*d).mul(y)`, which is reassociation
lever (b)(i): `sum_i mu_i * g * c_i` becomes `g * sum_i mu_i c_i` at slots 14 (eleven clauses) and 17 (five).  Distributivity; the gate `g` is a table value and multiplies the same clause batch
`limbs(v, &ix)` becomes a closure `lb` over a precomputed weight vector of the SAME `pow256(kk)`, with the `256^0` multiply by one dropped.  Same sum
two `#[cfg(test)]` blocks that hand the closure's captures to `s35_tests` and one `#[cfg(test)] s35.check(...)` call per arm: not compiled into a production build
stage_35_claim.scope: `argument.rs` is the ONLY port-relevant file that moved between `4ccbad1` and the lane tip `fee1a8d` (137 added, 18 deleted); `protocol.rs`, `layout.rs`, `pad.rs`, `plane_index.rs`, `run_capture.rs`, `boundary.rs`, `witness.rs` and `zk.rs` are byte-identical
stage_35_claim.verdict: UPHELD for everything these ports model.  No table is added, removed or reordered; no `definition_challenges` draw, no absorb, no `pad_on`, no `n_pad`, no declared degree and no push order moves; every rewrite is an identity of the same polynomial (distributivity, reassociation, a multiply by one dropped, and a constant with zero imaginary part taking the base-field multiply).  Slots 14 and 17 are two of the twenty-three the hand port evaluates, and after the rewrite they are the same function of the same tables
